title: Ideas board — vote on what we build next
notes: NEW: Ideas board. See every reviewed idea and tap 👍 to vote. The most-voted ideas get built first.
Pick a topic when you send an idea (Signals, Charts, Alerts, Quiz, Other).
See the next update date. Small ideas ship every 2 weeks, big features on the 1st of the month.
Report bugs privately. Bug fixes ship every week.
Built ideas are marked ✅, so you can see your votes turn into updates.
